title: Master Control Handle
summary: A combined traction and braking controller with eight configured positions.
purpose: Request propulsion, neutral/coasting, service braking or emergency braking from the driving desk.
observations: P1, P2 and P3 request increasing levels of traction.
N requests neither active traction nor service braking from the handle.
B1, B2 and B3 request increasing levels of service braking; EB requests emergency braking.
interactions: Identify each of the eight configured detents.
Compare speedometer response during power, neutral and braking requests.
Explain the distinction between a command and the response shown by instruments.
safetyNotes: The eight-detent layout is specific to this teaching cab; actual driver controllers vary.
A traction request should only be made when required door and other operating conditions are satisfied.
